# Synthetic reader operating instruction — reuse preflight only

This is a non-subject operational instruction. It is explicitly authorized as the one bootstrap instruction input; it is not a third subject input. The synthetic fixture route is not a real reader test or a teaching verdict.

Run the exact sealed `bootstrap.js` once through `functions.exec`, before retrieval. It may read only this operating instruction, sealed operational code, and subject-free route metadata. It must not retrieve any subject bytes, dispatch a real reader, or execute a subject file.

After bootstrap, use the exact sealed `short_call.js` through a new `functions.exec` cell for each route step. Edit only the string literal assigned to `STEP_ID`. Do not reproduce, repair, or rewrite the adapter, its hash implementation, launcher, receipt logic, verifier, bootstrap, or short-call wrapper. Do not add a path, range, executable, or extra datum. The only allowed inputs for content retrieval are the route step IDs provided by the orchestrator. A baseline revisit is also one predeclared STEP_ID.

The cache contains only operational code and binding metadata. Each step verifies current code, helper, wrapper, and route byte identities and compares the complete cached envelope before evaluating the exact operational adapter. Returned subject text, packets, paths, bytes, and figures never enter executable positions. A missing or stale store, a code or binding mismatch, truncation, rejected step, tool failure, or receipt failure means stop and preserve the failure; do not reload, improvise retrieval, reset state, or retry exposure.

The adapter retains the preflighted launcher and receipt invariants. Complete initial baseline access precedes teaching. Text cursor advancement occurs at verified retrieval; text delivery is separately receipted after output/yield. A figure remains held after bytes are staged, after invocation, and after the actual tool result. Only complete identified image output followed by delivery receipt releases it.

This is instruction-confined retrieval, not a technical sandbox. Other tools remain available; neither eval nor store prevents deliberate instruction violations. Receipts require comparison with the actual transcript. These controls do not establish semantic understanding, simultaneous context residency, absence of prior knowledge, memory erasure, or real reader admission.
